title: Reverse Story · Classic
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Reverse Story · Classic with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Agree on a simple fictional event with a beginning, middle and end. The lead tells the three parts starting with the ending and finishing with the beginning. The group can identify all three parts in reverse order. Each player takes two turns. Give the lead one point for each successful turn. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Reverse Story, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The group can identify all three parts in reverse order.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
recall.why: The group can identify all three parts in reverse order.
